summary: WorkReadPort::cicd_stage_log: one CI/CD stage's bounded log view (errors/tests/console) assembled from jenkins_stage_results over the task's correlation family, ported from WorkStore.cicd_stage_log.
signature: pub(crate) fn cicd_stage_log(store: &crate::work_store::PgWorkStore, project_alias: &str, task_id: uuid::Uuid, correlation_id: uuid::Uuid, action_id: uuid::Uuid, stage_id: &str, view: &str, cursor_token: Option<&str>) -> Result<forge_work::StageLogView, forge_work::WorkError>;
responsibilities: Validate: stage_id matches [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64} and view is one of errors/tests/console, else rejected(400, invalid_request). The cursor token, when present, matches ^[0-9a-f]{64}\.(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,7})$ and yields (digest, offset); the digest is accepted and not re-checked in v1 (Python binds it to the stage log digest it minted; the v1 view mints the same format).

In one read transaction: SELECT id, correlation_id, workflow_id, repair_root_task_id FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks WHERE owner_id=$1 AND project_alias=$2 AND id=$3; no row -> not_found(task); correlation mismatch -> rejected(403, denied). root = repair_root_task_id or id.

Run linked_family_tasks (pinned) and collect the family correlation ids plus the task's own. Check the table exists: SELECT to_regclass('forge_agent.jenkins_stage_results') IS NOT NULL; absent -> not_found(stage log).
Run stage_log_rows (pinned) with the family correlation ids; no rows -> not_found(stage log).

Assemble the full text by view: errors -> the rows' non-empty error_excerpt values joined with blank lines, truncated to 4096 UTF-8 bytes on a char boundary and right-trimmed; tests -> a JSON text of {passed, failed, skipped sums (null when no int values), cases: up to 64 {name (<=160 chars), status} from test_summary.cases}; console -> the concatenation over rows in order of "## {label or logical_stage_id} [{status}]" lines plus each row's error_excerpt when present (v1 console subset).

Apply the byte window: content = full text bytes [offset .. offset+32768] decoded as the longest valid UTF-8 prefix; StageLogView { stage_id, content, next_cursor: Some(format!("{digest}.{next}")) when more bytes remain (digest = sha256 hex of the full text), else None }. The first page's digest is the sha256 of the full assembled text.
invariants: The Python view assembly for console interleaves Jenkins event payloads; v1 assembles from stage rows only (documented subset).
Windows never split a UTF-8 codepoint.
